Company Description

Buck.ai is an automation platform that uses cutting-edge artificial intelligence (AI) tech to smartly automate business processes for home service companies. The platform helps these companies grow profits and reduce costs by automating day-to-day processes and maximizing efficiency.

Job Summary:

As an AI Team Lead at Buck.AI, you will oversee a talented team of AI specialists and engineers. Your leadership will drive the development and implementation of machine learning models and AI solutions that enhance our products and services. This role combines strategic planning, team mentorship, and hands-on technical expertise. Experience in LLMs and creating Conversational AI experiences is a plus.

- Design and implement innovative AI strategies to solve complex problems.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate AI solutions into our products.

- Stay abreast of industry trends and advancements in AI and machine learning.

- Manage the AI project lifecycle from conception to deployment.

- Ensure the technical excellence and scalability of AI systems.

Qualifications:

- Master’s or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related field.

- Minimum of 5 years of experience in AI or machine learning, with at least two years in a leadership role.

- Proven track record of developing and deploying machine learning models.

- Strong programming skills in Python, R, or similar.

- Excellent communication and leadership skills.

Preferred Skills:

- Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure).

- Knowledge of deep learning frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch).

- Prior experience in applied AI projects involving LLMs.

Why Join Us:

- Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package.

- Opportunities for professional growth and advancement.

- Work on exciting, transformative projects using cutting-edge technologies.

- Collaborative and innovative work environment.

Looking for an opportunity to make an impact?

Unleash your potential at Leidos, where we deliver innovative solutions through the efforts of our diverse and talented people who are dedicated to our customer's success. We empower our teams, contribute to our communities, and operate sustainably. Everything we do is built on a commitment to do the right thing for our customers, our people, and our community. Our Mission, Vision, and Values guide the way we do business.

If this sounds like an environment where you can thrive, keep reading!

Are you ready to join a team of intelligent and motivated professionals in shaping and improving the consumer fraud protection industry? Leidos is in search of a Generative AI Solutions Developer who excels in leveraging existing Gen AI to create innovative solutions for our customers. The ideal candidate is skilled in prompt engineering, retrieval augmented generation, and deploying AI technologies at scale for production use, ensuring AI solutions meet or exceed quality and performance requirements. This role also requires an understanding of operating solutions using cloud technologies including Azure and AWS platforms.

Responsibilities:
• Apply prompt engineering techniques to effectively utilize generative AI models for content creation, data analysis, and problem-solving.
• Integrate AI functionalities into applications and systems using API-based models (e.g., Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock) or by managing open-source models in a cloud environment.
• Collaborate with technical and business teams to translate requirements into scalable AI solutions.
• Ensure the secure and efficient deployment of AI solutions on cloud platforms (Azure or AWS), managing resources and optimizing performance.
• Ensure that all AI solutions are developed and deployed in an ethical, unbiased, and responsible manner, adhering to industry best practices and company guidelines.
• Fine-tune Large Language Models to enhance their performance and relevance to specific customer needs.
• Stay updated with the latest in AI technologies and cloud solutions to continually enhance our offerings.

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
• A growth mindset with a proven track record of learning and implementing new technologies and methodologies in the AI and cloud computing domains. Must demonstrate adaptability in the face of evolving project requirements and technology landscapes.
• At least 4 years of experience including production deployments of AI/machine learning solutions with demonstrated business value delivery.
• Proven expertise in prompt engineering, retrieval augmented generation, and embeddings to tailor AI outputs to achieve needed quality levels.
• Experience with cloud computing platforms (Azure or AWS), including deployment, management, and optimization of AI models in the cloud to deliver needed performance levels.
• Familiarity with AI model fine-tuning techniques and tools, with a focus on generative AI applications.
• Proficiency in programming languages relevant to AI development (e.g., Python) and understanding of API integration.

• Knowledge of security best practices for AI solutions in the cloud.
• Excellent communication skills for collaborating across teams and with clients.

job_description:
McClatchy, a digitally driven media company focused on innovation, seeks a dedicated AI Innovation Journalist & Developer who will sit at the intersection of journalism and technology. This position is aimed at integrating artificial intelligence in ways that enhance our storytelling and reporting capabilities.

Reporting to the Lead Editor for AI Innovation in Journalism, the AI Innovation Journalist/Developer will play a crucial role in our newsrooms' ongoing digital transformation. This position requires a unique blend of journalistic prowess, traditional journalistic integrity and a keen interest in AI technologies.

The position will be part of a small team tasked with driving sustainable innovation around AI technology across McClatchy's newsrooms. Your role will focus on using AI technology to enhance our journalism, and working directly with our journalists on the strategic implementation and development of AI tools.

You will be instrumental in exploring, testing, and implementing AI tools within our reporting processes, contributing to in-house tool development and helping journalists across our markets in using AI tools to elevate their work. This includes training our journalists in the use of AI technologies.

This position is remote but will ideally be located near one of McClatchy’s 30 markets.

The anticipated base pay range for this position is between $60,000 and $75,000 a year. Individual base pay may vary within that range depending on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, relevant education, department equity, training, geography and local wage and hours laws.

What You’ll Bring
• Collaborate closely with the Lead Editor for AI Innovation to identify and evaluate AI technologies that can enhance reporting and journalism.
• Actively participate in the testing and adoption of AI tools across McClatchy’s newsrooms, documenting best practices, lessons from failure and success stories.
• Contribute to the development of custom AI solutions tailored to the needs of our journalists and audiences.
• Support the rollout of AI training initiatives, assisting colleagues in navigating and utilizing new tools effectively.
• Serve as a liaison between the AI innovation team and newsrooms, ensuring a smooth integration of AI technologies into daily journalistic practices.

Required Knowledge, Skills And Abilities
• Bachelor's degree in Journalism, Communications, or a related field.
• Demonstrable experience in journalism or reporting.
• A strong interest in and experience with artificial intelligence and its application in journalism.
• A solid understanding of journalistic principles and ethics. Proficiency with one or more coding languages (R, Python, JavaScript etc.) for data analysis
• Experience documenting and reviewing code in a team-based environment
• Quick learner with the ability to adapt to and embrace new technologies.
• Excellent communication and collaboration skills, capable of working effectively in a team-oriented environment.
• Ability to translate complex technical concepts in clear, engaging ways.

What We’ll Bring
• A chance to be at the forefront of integrating AI technology into journalism, shaping the future of news reporting.
• A flexible, remote working environment.
• Competitive salary and benefits package.
• A culture that values innovation, inclusivity, and professional development.

As a journalist at McClatchy, you will join a supportive, flexible, collaborative team. McClatchy strives to be an employer of choice, and our benefits package is made with this goal in mind. With a focus on health, well-being, wealth and daily life, our package options include healthcare coverage for employees and their families, financial protection from expected and unexpected expenses, multiple no-cost wellness resources and even coverage for four-legged friends.

Our overall benefits package also includes a 401(k) with employer match, competitive paid time off and corporate holidays, and a variety of mental health benefits. With an excellent support team and with focus on your well-being as a top corporate strategy, McClatchy provides benefits to support you and your family in achieving your health and wellness goals. For more information on McClatchy's benefit plan, please visit McClatchyLivewell.com.

How To Apply

Interested candidates should submit their resume, cover letter, and samples of their work through our careers portal at McClatchy Careers. Your cover letter should highlight your interest in AI and journalism, and how you believe AI can transform the industry.

About McClatchy

Our impact is growing every day. 30 growing markets. Over 65 million monthly readers. 57 Pulitzer Prizes. A strong portfolio of dynamic partnerships and smart investments. Our award-winning journalism, digital reach, and commitment to innovative growth have never been stronger.

job_description:
Principal AI Technology Expert

Job Summary:

At Capital One, we are currently in search of a Senior Distinguished Engineer for AI Systems to help us shape the groundwork of our enterprise's AI capabilities. In this role, you will be working closely with a team of AI researchers and engineers in designing and developing secure infrastructures, large-scale distributed training clusters, and advanced AI research and development ventures. The ideal candidate must have extensive knowledge of cloud environments, distributed computing, and machine learning, as well as a passion for driving innovation in the financial industry.

Job Duties and Responsibilities:
• Establish a strong system to sustain protracted high-stakes training regimens, incorporating checkpoint libraries and container technology.
• Investing in the infrastructure for running large machine learning models is necessary to maintain a competitive edge in the public cloud environment and meet the needs of our customers.
• A public-cloud based training cluster, equipped with a thousand nodes, can be established and optimized by focusing on refining both the storage and networking stack, yielding extraordinary performance and elevated efficiency of training tasks.
• Analyze benchmarks data to identify areas where AI software systems can be optimized to improve performance, such as optimizing algorithms, improving data handling processes, or selecting more advanced hardware or architectures.
• Employ large language models (LLMs) and feature models (FMs) to create applications that are powerful, user-friendly, and customizable, with seamless integration and exceptional customer service.
• Documentation is crucial for effective MLOps for foundation models. Clear and concise documentation can help ensure that team members understand the model's architecture, dependencies, and performance metrics.

Qualifications and Experience:
• A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a similar technical field is a requirement for consideration for this job opening.
• My professional background revolves around designing and constructing distributed computing, HPC, and large-scale ML models over the past seven years.
• Proficient in Python or C/C++, with valuable expertise in developing AI and ML algorithms gained over 5+ years of experience.
• I possess an impressive 3 years of experience in the complete lifecycle of machine learning development, working with AI and ML frameworks, along with the public cloud.

Preferred Qualifications:
• The candidate should possess a background in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field and either a Master's degree or PhD in the area, or an equivalent level of practical experience that concentrates on present-day AI techniques.
• Proficient in building cloud-based distributed systems in AWS, Azure, or GCP.
• As an experienced cloud systems architect, the candidate has a deep understanding of how to create an optimized cloud environment that is secure, scalable, high-performing, and cost-effective, catering to the specific needs of each client.
• We have the capability to handle vast models throughout the MLOps pipeline, including exploratory research and final deployment.
• Building a GPU cluster in the public cloud necessitates the proper integration of storage and networking necessities, yet the rewards are significant, making the experience worthwhile.
• Adequate experience in utilizing the entire technology stack for distributed training of extensive models, involving various tools and platforms like ML compilers, distributed training frameworks, and ML development frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, Lightning, etc.
• My experience with the AI technology stack, which includes prompt engineering, guardrails, vector databases/knowledge bases, LLM hosting, and fine-tuning, allows me to build intelligent products and services meeting the needs of clients.
• Proven expertise in neural networks, distributed training, and SysML indicated by distinguished research publications presented at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences, or substantial contributions to the industry.

Benefits of the Position:
• Performance-based incentive compensation, which involves remuneration that is tied to an individual's performance, can take the form of cash bonuses and long-term incentives.
• Our company takes a holistic approach to employee well-being, providing comprehensive benefits that support physical health, financial stability, and more.
• Capital One offers several avenues for professional advancement and personal growth for its employees.
• Personal and professional expansion is encouraged in the welcoming and encouraging work environment.

About Company:

Committed to developing trustworthy, reliable AI systems that incorporate human input, Capital one is dedicated to revolutionizing the banking industry. We continue to focus on machine learning and AI technologies to deliver intelligent and automated customer experiences. Our extensive investments in public cloud infrastructure and machine learning platforms distinguish us and position us uniquely to harness AI's power. Join our team and participate in reimagining how we serve our clients and businesses while directly shaping the future of banking.

Expand your career possibilities.

Thank you for dedicating your time and talent to Lowe’s. We want to give you more opportunities to learn and grow, so if you find a position you’re interested in below, we encourage you to apply!

Find Your Home to More Possibilities.

Job Summary
The primary purpose of this role is to translate business requirements and functional specifications into logical program designs and to deliver code modules, stable application systems, and software solutions. This includes developing, configuring, or modifying integrated business and/or enterprise application solutions within various computing environments. This role facilitates the implementation and maintenance of business and enterprise software solutions to ensure successful deployment of released applications.

Key Responsibilities
• Translates business requirements and specifications into logical program designs, code modules, stable application systems, and software solutions with occasional guidance from senior colleagues; partners with Product Team to understand business needs and functional specifications
• Develops, configures, or modifies integrated business and/or enterprise application solutions within various computing environments by designing and coding component-based applications using various programming languages
• Tests application using TDD and BDD frameworks (e.g., jest, cypress, mockito, selenium, cucumber, etc.)
• Conducts root cause analysis of issues; reviews new and existing code
• Implements continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) processes to ensure quality and efficiency in the development cycle using tools such as Jenkins, Git, Gradle, Spinnaker, JFrog, etc.
• Ideates, builds, and publishes reusable libraries to improve productivity across teams
• Conducts the implementation and maintenance of complex business and enterprise software solutions to ensure successful deployment of released applications
• Solves difficult technical problems; solutions are testable, maintainable, and efficient
• Demonstrates strong understanding of at least 1 of the four competencies below with working knowledge of 1 other: • Fronted: Building UI using React and NodeJS with proficiency in JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML and CSS • Middleware: Building resource efficient, scalable, and resilient Microservices and APIs using Java/Python/Go. • Databases: Building optimal database persistence solutions using right database technologies (ex, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Elasticsearch, Redis, KAFKA etc) • DevOps: Creating automated CI-CD processes using containerization solutions (Docker), CI tools (Drone, Jenkins, Spinnaker), Orchestration (Kubernetes, Helm) and Infrastructure automation (ArgoCD, Rancher, Ansible, Terraform, Chef)
• Actively contribute to AI platform development, ensuring the platform remains adaptable and efficient in hosting a variety of ML models. This includes scaling the platform for high performance and integrating new AI capabilities as APIs.
• Design, develop, and implement tools and frameworks that support ML experimentation and deployment. Your work will enable the platform to offer advanced AI functionalities seamlessly.
• Strategically manage GPU and CPU resources to optimize the execution of AI models. Your expertise will ensure that the platform runs efficiently, balancing performance with cost-effectiveness.
• Work closely with data scientists and LLM experts to integrate AI models smoothly into platform. Your role will be pivotal in bridging technical development and AI research, promoting a collaborative environment that fosters innovation.

• 2 years of experience in software development or a related field

• 4 years of experience working with defect or incident tracking software
• 4 years of experience with technical documentation in a software development environment
• 2 years of experience working with an IT Infrastructure Library (ITIL) framework

job_title: Vice President, AI Innovation Solutions and Partnerships
job_description:
MKE Tech Hub Coalition is a non-profit with the mission of inclusively growing the tech ecosystem in SE Wisconsin in order to create enduring economic prosperity and life-changing opportunities for individuals. Recognizing the criticality of AI to our global competitiveness, we are investing in building offerings which will help businesses adopt AI and to help their talent thrive.

Role Summary: The MKE Tech Hub Coalition is seeking a visionary and results-oriented Vice President of AI Innovation Solutions and Partnerships, to play a pivotal role in driving the growth and impact of the MKE Tech Hub Coalition in alignment. This strategic leader will be responsible for developing the strategy, offerings, partnerships, and funding sources. The ideal candidate will possess a proven track record of success in building and leveraging high-impact partnerships, a deep understanding of the technology landscape with a focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI), and a passion for fostering collaboration and innovation within the Milwaukee tech ecosystem.

Responsibilities:

Strategic Partnerships:
• Partner with our member organizations and prospective partners organizations to inform our metrics of success, offerings, and partnerships
• Develop and implement a comprehensive partnership strategy to identify, attract, and engage potential partners across industry sectors, academia, government agencies, and non-profit organizations.
• Lead the negotiation and execution of mutually beneficial partnership agreements, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives.
• Manage existing partnerships, fostering strong relationships and maximizing the value derived from each collaboration.
• Develop and implement a robust partnership management system to track progress, measure success, and ensure accountability.

Product Launch - AI Innovation:
• Champion the launch of programs designed to increase adoption of AI technologies in order to expand our global competitiveness
• Oversee the selection, development, and implementation of the pilots and scale existing, successful pilots
• Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure the pilots' success, including subject matter experts, partner organizations, and participating communities.
• Measure the impact of the pilots and develop a plan for scaling or replicating successful initiatives.

Identify Funding Streams and Secure Bigger Sponsors:
• Conduct comprehensive research to identify diverse funding streams that support the MKE Tech Hub Coalition's mission and strategic initiatives.
• Develop compelling grant proposals and sponsorship packages that showcase the MKE Tech Hub Coalition’s value proposition and potential return on investment.
• Lead the process of securing larger sponsors and donors, cultivating long-term relationships with key funders.
• Manage grant and sponsorship programs, ensuring compliance with all reporting requirements.

Additional Responsibilities:
• Stay abreast of the latest trends in AI innovation and technology partnerships, implementing best practices into MKE Tech Hub Coalition’s offerings
• Represent the MKE Tech Hub at industry events, conferences, and meetings, building brand awareness and fostering collaboration.
• Develop and lead communication strategies to increase visibility for the MKE Tech Hub Coalition’s partnerships and initiatives.
• Serve as a trusted advisor to the CEO, Board, and partners, providing strategic insights and recommendations.

Qualifications:
• Bachelor’s in business, technology, or related field. Master's degree is preferred
• Minimum 5+ years of experience in a senior leadership role, with a proven track record of success in building and managing strategic partnerships.
• Demonstrated experience in launching new technology products or pilot programs, preferably within the AI space.
• Extensive knowledge of funding sources and experience in securing grants and sponsorship agreements.
• Strong understanding of the technology landscape, with a particular focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions.
• Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build strong relationships at all levels.
• Proven ability to influence, negotiate, and secure mutually beneficial collaborations.

Principal AI Technology Expert

Job Summary:

At Capital One, we are currently in search of a Senior Distinguished Engineer for AI Systems to help us shape the groundwork of our enterprise's AI capabilities. In this role, you will be working closely with a team of AI researchers and engineers in designing and developing secure infrastructures, large-scale distributed training clusters, and advanced AI research and development ventures. The ideal candidate must have extensive knowledge of cloud environments, distributed computing, and machine learning, as well as a passion for driving innovation in the financial industry.

Job Duties and Responsibilities:
• Establish a strong system to sustain protracted high-stakes training regimens, incorporating checkpoint libraries and container technology.
• Investing in the infrastructure for running large machine learning models is necessary to maintain a competitive edge in the public cloud environment and meet the needs of our customers.
• A public-cloud based training cluster, equipped with a thousand nodes, can be established and optimized by focusing on refining both the storage and networking stack, yielding extraordinary performance and elevated efficiency of training tasks.
• Analyze benchmarks data to identify areas where AI software systems can be optimized to improve performance, such as optimizing algorithms, improving data handling processes, or selecting more advanced hardware or architectures.
• Employ large language models (LLMs) and feature models (FMs) to create applications that are powerful, user-friendly, and customizable, with seamless integration and exceptional customer service.
• Documentation is crucial for effective MLOps for foundation models. Clear and concise documentation can help ensure that team members understand the model's architecture, dependencies, and performance metrics.

Qualifications and Experience:
• A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a similar technical field is a requirement for consideration for this job opening.
• My professional background revolves around designing and constructing distributed computing, HPC, and large-scale ML models over the past seven years.
• Proficient in Python or C/C++, with valuable expertise in developing AI and ML algorithms gained over 5+ years of experience.
• I possess an impressive 3 years of experience in the complete lifecycle of machine learning development, working with AI and ML frameworks, along with the public cloud.

• The candidate should possess a background in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field and either a Master's degree or PhD in the area, or an equivalent level of practical experience that concentrates on present-day AI techniques.

• As an experienced cloud systems architect, the candidate has a deep understanding of how to create an optimized cloud environment that is secure, scalable, high-performing, and cost-effective, catering to the specific needs of each client.
• We have the capability to handle vast models throughout the MLOps pipeline, including exploratory research and final deployment.

job_description:
McClatchy, a digitally driven media company focused on innovation, seeks a dynamic and experienced Lead Editor to spearhead the integration and advancement of Artificial Intelligence (AI) technologies within our News operation.

This position offers a unique opportunity to blend traditional journalistic integrity with leadership around cutting-edge AI tools, shaping the future of news reporting and AI-assisted journalism across McClatchy’s 30 markets.

A successful candidate has demonstrated success in journalism, leadership and innovation. We’re looking for an editor who can help us elevate our reporting and continue evolving as AI technology changes.

As the Lead Editor for AI Innovation in Journalism, you will head a small, dedicated team tasked with driving sustainable innovation around AI across McClatchy's newsrooms. Your role will focus on elevating and improving our journalism, and assisting our journalists, through the strategic implementation and development of AI tools.

This includes: developing in-house solutions, creating innovative approaches to newsroom challenges, assisting journalists in AI tool usage, developing AI training programs within News and contributing to high-level AI strategy within the News Division.

This position is remote but will ideally be located near one of McClatchy’s 30 markets.

Essential Duties/Responsibilities
• Lead a small, agile team focused on AI innovation within our journalism practices.
• Evaluate, test, and recommend cutting-edge AI journalism-focused tools and technologies to keep McClatchy at the forefront of AI-enhanced reporting.
• Develop AI solutions tailored to the unique needs and challenges of our newsrooms and our journalists. Work in partnership with newsrooms to identify and prioritize projects for maximum impact. Work in partnership with product/experience and technology teams on wider solutions.
• Craft and document innovative strategies to solve complex newsroom problems using AI technology.
• Provide hands-on support to journalists across our 30 newsrooms, facilitating the effective use of AI tools in their reporting and storytelling.
• Design and implement comprehensive AI training programs for our journalists, fostering a culture of continuous learning and innovation.
• Play a key role in the development and execution of McClatchy’s overarching AI strategy within the News Division, ensuring alignment with our journalistic values and objectives.

Location: Flexible/Remote

The anticipated base pay range for this position is between $90,000 and $110,000 a year. Individual base pay may vary within that range depending on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, relevant education, department equity, training, geography and local wage and hours laws.

What You’ll Bring
• Bachelor's degree in Journalism, Computer Science, or a related field. Advanced degree preferred.
• Proven experience in newsroom operations and a solid understanding of journalistic principles and ethics.
• Strong background in AI technologies and their application in a journalistic context, including past proficiency in executing AI or automation projects. Familiarity with one or more coding languages (R, Python, JavaScript etc.)
• Demonstrated ability to lead and manage teams, driving projects from conception to completion.
• Excellent problem-solving skills and the capacity to create innovative solutions to journalistic challenges.
• Outstanding communication skills, with the ability to train and support non-technical users in the adoption of new technologies.
• A visionary mindset, with a passion for leveraging technology to enhance journalistic quality and impact.

What We’ll Bring:
• The opportunity to play a pivotal role in integrating AI technology into the fabric of our journalism, impacting the way news is reported, produced, and consumed.
• A flexible, remote working environment.
• Competitive salary and benefits package.
• A collaborative, innovative, and inclusive company culture.

As a journalist at McClatchy, you will join a supportive, flexible, collaborative team. McClatchy strives to be an employer of choice, and our benefits package is made with this goal in mind. With a focus on health, well-being, wealth and daily life, our package options include healthcare coverage for employees and their families, financial protection from expected and unexpected expenses, multiple no-cost wellness resources and even coverage for four-legged friends.

Our overall benefits package also includes a 401(k) with employer match, competitive paid time off and corporate holidays, and a variety of mental health benefits. With an excellent support team and with focus on your well-being as a top corporate strategy, McClatchy provides benefits to support you and your family in achieving your health and wellness goals. For more information on McClatchy's benefit plan, please visit McClatchyLivewell.com.

How To Apply

Please submit your resume, cover letter, and any relevant work samples/portfolio via our careers portal at McClatchy Careers. Your cover letter should explain why you're passionate about AI in journalism and how your experience aligns with the key responsibilities and requirements of this role.

Our impact is growing every day. 30 growing markets. Over 65 million monthly readers. 57 Pulitzer Prizes. A strong portfolio of dynamic partnerships and smart investments. Our award-winning journalism, digital reach, and commitment to innovative growth have never been stronger.

As a member of the McClatchy family, you are part of a flexible, empowering, and exciting culture dedicated to creating a work/life balance and consistent opportunities for growth—a place where you have a voice and the ability to impact our future. It’s an exciting time to be here. Our company is experiencing the most transformative period in its history. Job Summary:

Capital One desires a Lead Generative AI Infrastructure Engineer to join our team, one who can help establish the groundwork of our AI capabilities. As part of this role, you will work on several projects, such as designing extensive distributed training clusters to deploy Large-Language Models (LLMs) on GPU instances for real-time use. You will also provide support for advanced AI research and development by working hand-in-hand with our cloud and container infrastructure teams on designing and integrating key functions.

Job Duties and Responsibilities:
• Optimize the storage and networking stacks of distributed training clusters deployed in the public cloud, enabling efficient large-scale computations to be performed.
• Use scalability to your advantage by divvying-up experiments in smaller well-defined chunks by using containers. Load-balance your workloads across multiple containers through a load balancer, coupled with a checkpointing library backup for the preceding task ensuring consistency, in case of any failure of the system.
• The aim is to create an efficient, cost-effective, and scalable run-time infrastructure for serving large and complex ML models such as LLMs and Foundation Models in the public cloud.
• Employ innovative technologies and tools to optimize the performance and reliability of search indexes and embeddings in vector databases.
• Assist in developing and implementing key capabilities by collaborating with cloud and container infrastructure teams and AI researchers.

Qualifications and Experience:
• To enroll in a Bachelor's program, a degree in a technical field like Computer Science or Computer Engineering is mandatory.
• The applicant must have a minimum of six years of experience building data-intensive solutions that utilize distributed computing.
• The applicant must have programmed with Python, Go, Scala, or Java for a minimum of six years.
• A fundamental requirement for this position is a minimum of one year's proficiency with High-Performance Computing (HPC), vector embedding, or semantic search technologies.
• Proficiency in building, scaling, and enhancing the performance of training or inferencing systems for deep neural networks, with a minimum of one year of experience.

Preferred Qualifications:
• To qualify for this position, you must possess a Master's or Doctoral degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mathematics, or a similar area of study.

• Someone with deep expertise in constructing GPU clusters within the public cloud, specifically in relation to the integration of storage and networking components for optimal performance.

CreateBase is a cutting-edge startup at the intersection of artificial intelligence, music, and the broader entertainment industry. We specialize in developing AI-driven tools that transform the creative process for artists, musicians, and content creators. Our mission is to leverage the power of machine learning to unlock new creative potentials and redefine the boundaries of music production and entertainment.

### The Opportunity

We're on the lookout for a Machine Learning Engineer with a solid background in the music and entertainment sectors. This role is ideal for someone who combines deep technical expertise in machine learning with a passion for music and entertainment. You will be instrumental in building and optimizing AI models that drive our innovative audio transformation tools and other creative applications.

### Responsibilities
• Design, develop, and deploy machine learning models that serve as the backbone for our AI-driven music and entertainment products.
• Collaborate with product managers, music experts, and engineers to understand user needs and translate them into technical requirements and innovative solutions.
• Conduct research and implement algorithms in areas such as audio signal processing, music information retrieval, generative models for music, and voice synthesis.
• Optimize existing machine learning pipelines for better efficiency, scalability, and performance.
• Stay abreast of the latest advancements in AI, machine learning, and computational creativity, applying new findings to our product development efforts.

At The Matchbox, our mission is to revolutionize work experiences and productivity on a global scale. Our pioneering Hybrid AI media production service integrates artificial intelligence with advertising, pushing the boundaries of creativity, efficiency, and personalization. We offer comprehensive services in Hybrid AI media production, branding solutions, CTV, and paid media strategies. By leveraging cutting-edge technology, we cater to a segmented audience in a crowded market, matching the right products with the right individuals to enhance productivity and reshape work experiences worldwide. Join us in our mission.

This role is designed for backend software engineers who are enthusiastic about building scalable, efficient systems that not only support our Hybrid AI media production program but also enhance the performance of Paid Media strategies. Job Summary:

At Capital One, we are currently in search of a Senior Distinguished Engineer for AI Systems to help us shape the groundwork of our enterprise's AI capabilities. In this role, you will be working closely with a team of AI researchers and engineers in designing and developing secure infrastructures, large-scale distributed training clusters, and advanced AI research and development ventures. The ideal candidate must have extensive knowledge of cloud environments, distributed computing, and machine learning, as well as a passion for driving innovation in the financial industry.

Job Duties and Responsibilities:
• Establish a strong system to sustain protracted high-stakes training regimens, incorporating checkpoint libraries and container technology.
• Investing in the infrastructure for running large machine learning models is necessary to maintain a competitive edge in the public cloud environment and meet the needs of our customers.
• A public-cloud based training cluster, equipped with a thousand nodes, can be established and optimized by focusing on refining both the storage and networking stack, yielding extraordinary performance and elevated efficiency of training tasks.
• Analyze benchmarks data to identify areas where AI software systems can be optimized to improve performance, such as optimizing algorithms, improving data handling processes, or selecting more advanced hardware or architectures.

• A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a similar technical field is a requirement for consideration for this job opening.
• My professional background revolves around designing and constructing distributed computing, HPC, and large-scale ML models over the past seven years.
• Proficient in Python or C/C++, with valuable expertise in developing AI and ML algorithms gained over 5+ years of experience.
• I possess an impressive 3 years of experience in the complete lifecycle of machine learning development, working with AI and ML frameworks, along with the public cloud.

What success looks like in this role:

Overview:

Unisys is a global technology solutions company that powers breakthroughs for the world's leading organizations and governments. Our offerings - Digital Workplace Services; Cloud, Applications & Infrastructure; Enterprise Computing Solutions; and Business Process Solutions help our clients challenge the status quo and create new possibilities. As a leading technology services and solutions provider, we are dedicated to helping businesses harness the power of data and artificial intelligence (AI), with emphasis on Generative AI to drive growth and innovation for our clients.

As part of our strategic growth, we are seeking an experienced and visionary Data and AI Practice Leader to build and lead a talented team to drive success for our clients. Focus areas:
• Identify & unlock new Generative AI-based growth.
• Leverage industry insight and perspective to engage clients with credibility.
• Develop use cases that drive new client interest.
• Drive differentiating outcomes that accelerate client success.
• Thought leadership driving a fresh and innovative narrative.

Job Description:

The Data and AI Practice Leader will be responsible for leading and growing a6 data and AI practice, emphasizing Generative AI, overseeing consulting and advisory services, the delivery of high-quality solutions, and driving business development efforts. This role will require delivering outcomes by integrating deep domain expertise in artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning (ML), and cloud with other industry best practices optimizing data to create imaginative new outcomes for clients.

Responsibilities:

Consultative Advisor: Advisor and partner with clients solving business problems by leveraging Generative AI. Credible client centricity, comfortable discussing issues at C-level, IT Executive or senior architect level influencing preference for differentiated solutions to challenges, practice offerings, capabilities and solutions.

Sales Orientation: Growth orientation building prospects. Intellectually curious, creative, and entrepreneurial. Pipeline development, generating the art of the possible challenging the status-quo to create new breakthroughs. Balance of sales and Solutioning with domain expertise in a few industries.

Client Engagement and Relationship Management: Develop strong relationships with clients, acting as a trusted partner. Collaborate closely with clients to understand their business challenges, identify opportunities, and deliver value-added solutions. Business Development: Initiate engagement with clients to identify and pursue new business opportunities. Engage with clients to understand their needs, develop tailored solutions, and present compelling proposals. Practice Leadership: Provide strategic direction and leadership to the data and AI practice, including setting goals, defining the vision, methodologies and establishing best practices. Solution Design and Delivery: Direct the design and delivery of end-to-end data and AI solutions, ensuring they align with clients' objectives, requirements, and industry best practices. Oversee the implementation, integration, and deployment of data and AI systems. Strong partner ecosystem orientation for delivery. Team Development and Management: Build and develop a high-performing team of data scientists, AI engineers, and consultants. Provide mentorship, guidance, and support to team members, fostering a culture of collaboration, continuous learning, and excellence. Thought Leadership: Depth in Generative AI, industry best practices, emerging technologies, and emerging developments in ML, AI and data management. Shared insights, conference presentations, and publication of thought leadership content to establish the company as a leader in the field. Project Direction: Ensure successful project execution by defining project plans, managing resources, monitoring progress, key dependencies, and mitigating risks. Drive projects to meet deadlines, budget constraints, with quality standards. Continuous Improvement: Continuously assess and improve the data and AI practice, including processes, tools, and methodologies. Identify areas for innovation, automation, and efficiency gains.

You will be successful in this role if you have:

Qualifications:
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Business Analytics, or a related field.
• An MBA or advanced degree is a plus.
• Proven experience (15+ years) in leading and managing data and AI teams or practices within a technology consulting or services environment.
• Strong understanding of Generative AI, data management principles, data architecture, and AI technologies, including machine learning, natural language processing, computer vision, and predictive analytics.

Job Summary:

Capital One desires a Lead Generative AI Infrastructure Engineer to join our team, one who can help establish the groundwork of our AI capabilities. As part of this role, you will work on several projects, such as designing extensive distributed training clusters to deploy Large-Language Models (LLMs) on GPU instances for real-time use. You will also provide support for advanced AI research and development by working hand-in-hand with our cloud and container infrastructure teams on designing and integrating key functions.

• Use scalability to your advantage by divvying-up experiments in smaller well-defined chunks by using containers. Load-balance your workloads across multiple containers through a load balancer, coupled with a checkpointing library backup for the preceding task ensuring consistency, in case of any failure of the system.
• The aim is to create an efficient, cost-effective, and scalable run-time infrastructure for serving large and complex ML models such as LLMs and Foundation Models in the public cloud.

About Us

At Hayden AI, we are on a mission to harness the power of artificial intelligence and machine learning to transform the way governments and businesses address real-world challenges.

From optimizing bus lane and bus stop enforcement to pioneering digital twin modeling and beyond, our innovative mobile perception system empowers our clients to accelerate transit, enhance street safety, and drive forward a sustainable future.

What the job involves

Our Engineering teams work at the cutting edge of technology, leveraging AWS and GCP cloud services and developing our own Linux-based edge devices. As a dynamic startup, we understand the critical importance of cybersecurity in protecting our innovative solutions and ensuring the safety of our digital environment and customer data.

We're looking for a passionate Security Engineer to lead our cybersecurity initiatives, safeguarding our code and infrastructure against the ever-evolving threats. You will manage security for our production and corporate systems, handle security alerts, implement policies, and collaborate with external customers on security needs.

Responsibilities
• Develop and implement comprehensive security strategies for our cloud environments (AWS and GCP) and Linux-based systems.
• Design and implement public/private key management and PKI (Private Key Infrastructure) for our edge devices.
• Perform regular security audits, risk assessments, and penetration testing to identify vulnerabilities in our code and infrastructure. This includes conducting thorough code audits from a security perspective to ensure our applications are developed with the highest security standards.
• Design and manage security protocols for our edge devices, ensuring robust protection against external threats.
• Stay abreast of the latest cybersecurity trends and threats, applying this knowledge to fortify our defenses. This includes proactive monitoring and implementing fixes for zero-day vulnerabilities to prevent exploitation.
• Develop and enforce security policies and procedures, conducting security awareness training across the company to cultivate a security-first culture.
• Collaborate with development teams to integrate security measures into the software development lifecycle (SDLC), promoting security best practices for application development to mitigate risks from the outset.
• Respond swiftly to any security incidents, leading the investigation and remediation efforts to minimize impact. This includes managing the resolution of security breaches and ensuring that similar vulnerabilities are addressed across all projects.
• Working with our partners and clients to have deep technical discussion about security posture, review and discuss the security requirements and formulate the necessary changes to the engineering team.
• Manage and maintain CIS compliant OS images for our Cloud infrastructure and field devices.
• Must possess demonstrable knowledge of application security, security testing methodologies and application security testing automation.

Qualifications
• Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
• 6+ years of software engineering or equivalent experience.
• Experience with one of the core (Golang, Python) programming languages, scripting and automation.
• Strong knowledge of encryption protocols, public/private key management and PKI (Private Key Infrastructure).
• Strong understanding of network security, encryption practices, and secure coding principles.
• Proven experience in cloud security management (AWS, Azure, GCP).
• Familiarity with security policies and controls for internal corporate applications (Google Workspace, GitHub, Jira).
• Familiarity with security compliance standards relevant to our industry.
• Strong skills in managing security tools and vendor relationships.
• Excellent ability to develop and implement security policies and guidelines.
• Understanding of the block chain principles is a plus.
• Relevant certifications in security and cloud platforms are highly desirable.

Benefits and Perks

There are endless learning and development opportunities from a highly diverse and talented peer group, including experts in a wide range of fields (AI, Computer Vision, Government Contracting, Systems & Device Engineering, Operations, Communications, and more!)
• Options for 100% company paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and dependents (for US employees)
• Flexible Spending Account (FSA) and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Account (DCFSA)
• Life, AD&D, Short and Long Term Disability Insurance
• Aflac Critical Illness, Accident Insurance & Hospital Indemnity Insurance
• MetLife Legal Plan(s) & Pet Insurance
• Farmers GroupSelect Auto & Home Insurance

• Professional development reimbursement
• Unlimited PTO
• Hybrid work opportunities
• Daily catered lunches in our San Francisco office

Hayden AI is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment that fosters learning from each other. We celebrate people of diverse backgrounds, experiences, abilities, and perspectives. We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing a work environment free of harassment and discrimination. Hayden AI is also committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, Hayden AI employees or any other company location. Hayden AI is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Lead AI Product Developer

Job Summary:

Capital One is on the lookout for a Lead Engineer with expertise in Generative AI Product Engineering to join their Enterprise AI team. The Lead Engineer will be responsible for building and managing APIs and SDKs used for the purpose of training, fine-tuning, and accessing AI models on a grand scale. You will work alongside an AI research team to develop and implement vital API products and services that enable real-time customer-facing applications.

Job Duties and Responsibilities:
• Generate and execute fundamental APIs and SDKs that equip users to access Large-Language Models (LLMs) and proprietary Foundation Models (FMs) for performing several activities, including fine-tuning, training, and prompting.
• Ease of use is a critical factor in the adoption of APIs. An intuitive interface, comprehensive documentation, and straightforward error messages are essential.
• By utilizing LLMs and FMs, you can create interfaces that are optimized for different applications, improving the overall usability and user experience.
• Provide users with the tools to construct new Generative AI functionalities.
• Implementing advanced processes and monitoring mechanisms can enable efficient identification and resolution of operational concerns and API access patterns.
• Consult with AI researchers to develop safety controls for the API layer and ensure ethical considerations are addressed.

Qualifications and Experience:
• The minimum educational requirement for this role is a bachelor’s degree that focuses on Computer Science, Computer Engineering or any allied field.
• A candidate must possess a minimum of 6 years of experience in constructing and designing data-driven solutions that take advantage of distributed computing and cache optimization techniques.
• A mandatory requirement for the perfect candidate is a background of at least six years in programming with Java, Scala, Go, or Python.
• We’re looking for applicants who have worked with deep neural network training or inference systems for a minimum of one year, who are well-versed in constructing, scaling, and refining these systems.

Preferred Qualifications:
• Comprehensive knowledge of creating large-scale AI products or platforms used by millions of users in NLP, speech, computer vision, or recommendation systems is a prerequisite.
• Being capable of performing effectively in a fast-moving environment with unclear expectations and competing obligations and deadlines.
• Employers favor applicants with prior experience at technology and product-centered companies and start-ups.
• Capability in deploying and operating intensive neural network models for demanding production environments.
• A comprehensive understanding of privacy best practices, including complying with data protection laws and regulations, ensuring transparent use of data, and providing privacy notices and consent forms to users.

Benefits of the Position:
• Offering monetary-driven awards that are linked to an employee's job performance is referred to as performance-based incentive compensation, which can vary from bonuses and commission to cash awards and profit-sharing plans.
• A comprehensive set of benefits promoting overall health and financial stability.
• There are plenty of opportunities available for employees to learn and grow professionally at Capital One.
• Foster growth on all levels, personal and professional, in a workplace that embraces inclusivity and supportiveness.

Capital One is constantly pushing the boundaries of what's possible in banking, thanks to our relentless pursuit of AI-driven technologies and customer-focused solutions.

Project Description:

We are seeking an experienced AI/ML Developer to create a sophisticated chatbot that functions as an interactive tutor for a range of educational courses. The chatbot should be capable of providing real-time feedback on assignments and case studies completed by students. Our current Learning Management System (LMS) is developed using Flutter and Firebase, and the chatbot should integrate seamlessly with this existing system.

Responsibilities:

Design and develop an AI-powered chatbot that can answer questions related to course content and provide explanations.

Integrate the chatbot with our LMS developed in Flutter and backed by Firebase for seamless user interaction.

Implement natural language processing (NLP) capabilities to ensure the chatbot understands and responds accurately to student queries.

Program the chatbot to assess student assignments and case studies, providing instant feedback and scoring.

Collaborate with educational experts to align chatbot responses with curriculum goals.

Continuously test, refine, and update the chatbot based on user feedback and performance data.

Requirements:

Strong programming skills in Python, and familiarity with AI development frameworks such as TensorFlow or PyTorch.

Experience with Flutter and Firebase for app development and data management.

Project Deliverables:

A fully functional AI chatbot integrated into our LMS.

Documentation outlining the chatbot’s design, functionalities, and integration process.

The initial development phase is expected to3-4 weeks, with potential for ongoing work based on project needs and performance.

Experience with Flutter and Firebase for app development and data management

Principal AI Product Engineer

Job Summary:

Capital One is currently in search of a Lead Engineer specializing in Generative AI Product Engineering to become part of their Enterprise AI team. The successful candidate will have the responsibility of creating and upholding APIs and SDKs for the purpose of training, fine-tuning and accessing AI models at a larger magnitude. The role will require close collaboration with a unit of AI engineers and researchers aimed at developing and executing major API products and services, which are crucial in enabling customer-facing applications in real-time.

Job Duties and Responsibilities:
• Design, construct, and release fundamental APIs and software development kits that allow users to interact with Large-Language Models (LLMs) and special Foundation Models (FMs), empowering them to conduct training, fine-tuning, and prompting tasks.
• When designing APIs, it is imperative to keep performance in mind. This means optimizing requests and responses to ensure minimal latency and maximum efficiency.
• Utilize LLMs and FMs to create customized interfaces that cater to the unique needs of different applications, enhancing the overall customer experience.
• Facilitate the development of novel Generative AI functionalities for users.
• Designing effective tools and procedures to keep a track of API access patterns and the operational well-being can prove to be beneficial for the organization.
• Work closely with researchers to develop and implement safety protocols and guardrails for AI in the API layer.

Qualifications and Experience:
• A four-year program in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or a related technical area leading to a bachelor’s degree is required.
• A minimum of 6 years of expertise in creating and establishing data-intensive solutions incorporating distributed computing and cache optimization strategies.
• The candidate should have a minimum of 6 years of expertise in coding with either Python, Go, Scala, or Java.
• The ideal candidate must possess a minimum of one year of experience in developing, optimizing, and expanding training or inference systems for deep neural networks.

Preferred Qualifications:
• A strong background in developing NLP, speech, computer vision, or recommendation systems, serving millions of users, is essential.
• Being able to excel in a dynamic atmosphere with unclear outcomes and overlapping responsibilities and time limits.
• Having a background in tech and product-oriented organizations is advantageous.
• Proficiency in implementing and deploying complex neural network models for use in high-pressure production scenarios.
• Significant knowledge in securing APIs, understanding the various types of threats and attacks that can be encountered and the measures to counteract them. Also, assess the robustness of API security protocols to identify potential weaknesses.

Benefits of the Position:
• Rewarding employees with a variable compensation system, tied to their performance, such as bonuses and incentives, is known as performance-based incentive compensation.
• Complete wellness package offering various health, financial, and other perks.
• Capital One offers numerous chances for professional advancement and personal growth to all its employees.
• An all-encompassing and encouraging work environment that nurtures individuals both personally and professionally.

About Company:

Capital One is dedicated to transforming the banking industry by providing AI systems that are trustworthy, dependable, and inherently human-friendly. By harnessing the power of machine learning and advanced AI technology, we strive to deliver personalized and timely solutions for our customers.

Principal AI Solutions Architect

Job Summary:

Capital One is seeking a Senior Distinguished Engineer for AI Systems to join our team and contribute to building the foundations of our enterprise AI capabilities. In this role, you will collaborate with a team of AI engineers and researchers to design and implement robust, secure infrastructure, large-scale distributed training clusters, and cutting-edge AI research and development projects. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in distributed computing, machine learning, and cloud environments, along with a passion for driving innovation in the banking industry.

Job Duties and Responsibilities:
• Design and build a fault-tolerant infrastructure for supporting lengthy high-stakes training tasks utilizing containers and checkpointing tools.
• The implementation of a reliable and scalable infrastructure to support the deployment and management of large machine learning models is crucial in ensuring the success of our public cloud services.
• A public-cloud based training cluster, equipped with a thousand nodes, can be established and optimized by focusing on refining both the storage and networking stack, yielding extraordinary performance and elevated efficiency of training tasks.
• Collaborate with development teams to develop best practices for benchmarking AI software systems, including protocols for testing, measuring, and reporting performance outcomes to ensure consistent and accurate performance testing.
• Drive user engagement and profitability in application development by harnessing the power of large language models (LLMs) and feature models (FMs) to deliver exceptional experiences that keep users coming back.
• Leveraging A/B testing techniques can help MLOps teams optimize the performance of foundation models by comparing different model architectures or training data to identify the most effective approach.

Qualifications and Experience:
• One of the prerequisites for this role is having a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or a related technical field.
• Over the last seven years, I have developed distributed computing, HPC, and high-level ML systems, bringing significant value to companies.
• Over the past 5+ years, expertise has been cultivated in Python or C/C++ programming languages, allowing for the development of innovative AI and ML algorithms.
• My experience with AI and ML frameworks, as well as the public cloud, spans over a remarkable 3+ years, providing me expertise in every stage of machine language development.

Preferred Qualifications:
• Applicants who have either a Master's degree or PhD in Engineering, Computer Science, or a comparable technical discipline, or have equivalent practical experience in the modern AI techniques field, are eligible for this position.
• Well-versed in conceptualizing intricate distributed systems within cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
• The candidate has a wealth of experience in designing cloud systems that meet the complex requirements of government and enterprise clients, delivering high-performance, scalable, and cost-effective cloud environments that adhere to strict security standards.
• Success in deploying large models through the MLOps life cycle is something we have achieved through a combination of experience, skill, and attention to detail.
• Building a GPU cluster in the public cloud necessitates the proper integration of storage and networking necessities, yet the rewards are significant, making the experience worthwhile.
• Knowledgeable in handling the complete technology stack for distributed training, enabling the training of extensive models by utilizing tools and platforms like ML compilers, distributed training frameworks, and ML development libraries like PyTorch, TensorFlow, Lightning, and more.
• By leveraging the latest offerings of AI technology stack, such as prompt engineering, guardrails, vector databases/knowledge bases, LLM hosting, and fine-tuning, I provide innovative and customized solutions to clients.
• Experienced knowledge in the fields of neural networks, distributed training, and SysML validated through accomplished research publications presented at premium peer-reviewed conferences or prominent contributions to the industry.

Lead AI Infrastructure Specialist

Job Summary:

Capital One desires a Lead Generative AI Infrastructure Engineer to join our team, one who can help establish the groundwork of our AI capabilities. As part of this role, you will work on several projects, such as designing extensive distributed training clusters to deploy Large-Language Models (LLMs) on GPU instances for real-time use. You will also provide support for advanced AI research and development by working hand-in-hand with our cloud and container infrastructure teams on designing and integrating key functions.

Job Duties and Responsibilities:
• Optimize the storage and networking stacks of distributed training clusters deployed in the public cloud, enabling efficient large-scale computations to be performed.
• Use scalability to your advantage by divvying-up experiments in smaller well-defined chunks by using containers. Load-balance your workloads across multiple containers through a load balancer, coupled with a checkpointing library backup for the preceding task ensuring consistency, in case of any failure of the system.
• The aim is to create an efficient, cost-effective, and scalable run-time infrastructure for serving large and complex ML models such as LLMs and Foundation Models in the public cloud.
• Employ innovative technologies and tools to optimize the performance and reliability of search indexes and embeddings in vector databases.
• Assist in developing and implementing key capabilities by collaborating with cloud and container infrastructure teams and AI researchers.

Qualifications and Experience:
• To enroll in a Bachelor's program, a degree in a technical field like Computer Science or Computer Engineering is mandatory.
• The applicant must have a minimum of six years of experience building data-intensive solutions that utilize distributed computing.
• The applicant must have programmed with Python, Go, Scala, or Java for a minimum of six years.
• A fundamental requirement for this position is a minimum of one year's proficiency with High-Performance Computing (HPC), vector embedding, or semantic search technologies.
• Proficiency in building, scaling, and enhancing the performance of training or inferencing systems for deep neural networks, with a minimum of one year of experience.

Preferred Qualifications:
• To qualify for this position, you must possess a Master's or Doctoral degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mathematics, or a similar area of study.
• Possessing a deep understanding of machine learning, as reflected in my extensive experience in training and deploying large-scale deep neural networks and transformer models across diverse industries.
• Skilled professionals who are well-versed in machine learning frameworks like TensorFlow, PyTorch, Lightning, or Mosaic ML are in high demand in diverse industries, including healthcare, finance, and automation.
• Talent to succeed in a lively surrounding with obscure expectations and competing targets and timelines.
• Preference is given to candidates who have experience in both product-driven companies and the tech industry.
• Skilled in deploying sophisticated neural network models in challenging production conditions.
• Someone with deep expertise in constructing GPU clusters within the public cloud, specifically in relation to the integration of storage and networking components for optimal performance.

Benefits of the Position:
• Performance-based incentive compensation programs are designed to incentivize employees to put forth their best effort and exceed expectations, resulting in improved organizational performance.
• Encouraging the total well-being of employees through a comprehensive benefits package, encompassing health, financial, and other benefits.
• Capital One invests in its workforce by creating opportunities for career development, offering ongoing training programs, and fostering a culture of learning.
• A work setting that encourages personal and professional development while promoting inclusivity and support.

Join us as we reimagine and shape the future of banking service provision to businesses and clients.

Crossover is the world's #1 source of full-time remote jobs. Our clients offer top-tier pay for top-tier talent. We're recruiting this role for our client, gt.school. Have you got what it takes?

Are you a seasoned software engineer with a deep interest in AI? Trilogy is on the lookout for exceptional engineers to lead the charge in adopting generative AI tools both in our development process and into our products.

Join us to work on our exciting product portfolio:
• TeachTap: Bringing historical figures to life using AI, offering an engaging, TikTok-like learning experience to make learning more relevant and fun.
• Educational Content Generation: Utilizing the latest in generative AI combined with comprehensive learning materials to create captivating content.
• TeachTower: A game-based motivation system inspired by popular games like Roblox and Minecraft, designed to make learning irresistibly fun.
• Coachbot: A learning copilot that integrates with existing apps, guiding learning paths, recommending next steps, and rewarding daily progress.

Your role will focus on integrating AI into engineering practices, using AI tools to increase efficiency and solve engineering tasks like coding and testing. Based on the obtained results, you will derive recipes and playbooks to be adopted by the broader engineering team. Maintaining high-quality standards in our codebases while ensuring high leverage of AI tools across our engineering teams will be a key part of your work.

You will be an integral part of our existing engineering team, working collaboratively on our suite of products to deeply understand our environment and needs. You will have the freedom to propose and experiment with new tools and then will leverage the insights and experiences obtained to evolve our processes, advocate for new tool adoption, or even spearhead the creation of small tools, bots, and frameworks to enhance our technical setup.

We seek candidates with a strong background in software engineering and a capacity for adapting to new technologies. Moreover, an interest in the latest generative AI developments and a drive for innovation are crucial. While our primary tech stack is AWS Serverless with TypeScript, we're looking for versatile engineers who can excel in a variety of technical environments and challenges.

What You Will Be Doing
• Developing fully functional features, using AI tools to expedite delivery and enhance quality.
• Performing experiments with AI to enhance engineering processes, including decomposition, solution design, code generation, and troubleshooting.
• Documenting best practices and techniques in guides that enable others to harness the power of generative AI effectively.

What You Won’t Be Doing
• Building new AI models from scratch; instead, your focus will be on leveraging and fine-tuning existing models to maximize efficiency.
• Being confined to outdated technologies; we encourage an environment that thrives on dynamic tech stacks, fostering continuous innovation.

Software Engineer (AI-Powered Development) Key Responsibilities
• Drive transformative change by establishing a framework that seamlessly integrates generative AI, significantly amplifying engineering productivity.

Basic Requirements
• Minimum 5 years of experience in professional software development.
• Minimum 3 years either as a lead engineer reviewing the work of other engineers or as an architect making important technical decisions.
• Excited to use and explore new generative AI tools for software engineering tasks on a day-to-day basis

About Gt.school

GT School is an EdTech Startup that leverages technology, AI, and subject matter experts to cultivate a new way of learning. Our unique approach leverages 50+ years of learning science, cutting-edge data analytics and high-performance coaching. In doing so, we can help students learn more, learn faster, and learn better - and have fun while doing it. We are a remote-first company that hires globally via Crossover.

There is so much to cover for this exciting role, and space here is limited. Hit the Apply button if you found this interesting and want to learn more. We look forward to meeting you!

This is a full-time (40 hours per week), long-term position. The position is immediately available and requires entering into an independent contractor agreement with Crossover. The compensation level for this role is $100 USD/hour, which equates to $200,000 USD/year assuming 40 hours per week and 50 weeks per year. The payment period is weekly.
